Geographies Served Programs Miyawaki – A Modern Plantation Drive Programme District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra In the era of digital technology, acquiring digital literacy is essential. However, India's ICT capabilities, particularly in government schools, face significant challenges due to limited IT infrastructure and digitally unskilled teachers. To address this, it aims to establish a technologically enhanced learning platform through its Digital Training and Resource Center (DTRC) initiative. This program includes digital labs equipped with computers and smartboards, offering technical education to equip government school students with digital skills, ultimately bridging the digital divide. Aayushmaan Aadhar Mobile Ambulance Programme State Andhra Pradesh Tamil Nadu West Bengal Gujarat Haryana Madhya Pradesh Maharashtra Rajasthan Uttar Pradesh Jammu and Kashmir States Andhra Pradesh Tamil Nadu West Bengal Gujarat Haryana Madhya Pradesh Maharashtra Rajasthan Uttar Pradesh Jammu and Kashmir The Aadhar Ambulance Initiative, a prominent project by the Y4D Foundation in collaboration with Aadhar Housing & Finance Ltd., addresses critical transportation needs. It focuses on delivering urgent pre-hospital medical care and stabilization for patients requiring immediate attention. Moreover, it extends immediate medical assistance to individuals in remote or inaccessible areas. Over the past two years, Y4D has tirelessly worked towards its mission of eliminating preventable fatalities, disabilities, and suffering caused by severe illnesses or injuries. Aayushmaan Aadhar Healthcare Programme State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Gujarat Kerala Maharashtra Telangana States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Gujarat Kerala Maharashtra Telangana The Y4D Health Care Initiative, conducted through Health Camps, is a vital programme dedicated to offering exceptional medical services and equipment free of charge. It also emphasizes educating participants on recognizing and managing common diseases to enhance the overall health of all citizens. These health camps, meticulously supervised by technical experts and medical professionals, operate with structured planning based on thorough baseline surveys. Over the past two years, Y4D has been committed to its mission of enhancing healthcare access for the disadvantaged population. Skill to Employability Programme District Hyderabad Gautam Buddha Nagar State Maharashtra Uttar Pradesh Telangana District Hyderabad Gautam Buddha Nagar States Maharashtra Uttar Pradesh Telangana Skill to Employability, a vocational training initiative by the Y4D Foundation, aligns with the National Skill Development Corporation's guidelines, focusing on empowering disadvantaged youth in India. The programme features a network of training centres nationwide, offering a month of comprehensive training, including classroom and practical sessions. Beyond technical skills, participants receive training in soft skills like financial literacy, personality development, and effective communication. The primary objective is to enhance their awareness of labour rights, ensuring they are well-prepared for future careers and greater financial independence through job placements. Financial Literacy Programme District Gurgaon State Haryana District Gurgaon States Haryana Financial literacy is the bedrock of financial relationships, an ongoing lifelong learning process. Initiating this learning early offers greater financial success. India currently lags in financial literacy compared to other emerging economies, making it a priority for economic growth. Y4D's project aims to bridge this gap, targeting high school and college students aged 15 and above. Implemented at the cluster level, it includes assessments, and successful participants receive certificates from the National Skill Development Corporation. The project's objective is to equip today's youth with financial knowledge for informed decision-making in their future endeavours. Tree planting Y4D Foundation employs a blend of traditional and modern tree-planting methods, including the Miyawaki technique developed by Dr. Akira Miyawaki. This innovative approach involves densely planting native tree species to establish a self-sustaining forest ecosystem. The technique utilizes soil enhancement, close seedling spacing, and mulching to promote rapid tree growth and ecological resilience. By adopting the Miyawaki Method, it aims to enhance the environmental impact of its tree planting initiatives, fostering a thriving, forest-like environment in compact spaces, benefiting wildlife, air quality, and climate change mitigation.
